job.title: Key Account Manager | Strategic Accounts - NZ
job.description:
Key Account Manager – Strategic Accounts

New Zealand


The Opportunity

My client is a global provider of industrial automation and pneumatic solutions, supporting customers across manufacturing, food & beverage, process industries and other industrial markets.

They are looking for an experienced Key Account Manager – Strategic Accounts to manage and grow relationships with major customers across New Zealand.

This is a senior customer-facing sales role focused on developing strategic accounts, identifying opportunities across customer operations and building long-term commercial partnerships. The successful candidate will work closely with engineering, procurement, operations and senior decision-makers to understand their requirements and provide suitable automation and pneumatic solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and develop a portfolio of strategic accounts across New Zealand
  • Build strong relationships with key customer stakeholders and decision-makers
  • Develop account strategies to support long-term sales growth
  • Identify opportunities to expand business across existing customer accounts
  • Develop new relationships and opportunities within targeted strategic customers
  • Promote industrial automation, pneumatic and motion control solutions
  • Understand customer applications and recommend suitable technical solutions
  • Manage commercial negotiations, quotations and major sales opportunities
  • Coordinate activities across multiple customer sites and stakeholders
  • Maintain account plans, sales forecasts and opportunity pipelines
  • Work closely with internal sales, engineering and technical teams
  • Maintain accurate customer and opportunity information within CRM systems
  • Monitor customer projects, market activity and competitor developments
  • Achieve agreed account growth, sales and profitability targets


About You

  • Proven experience in key account management, strategic account management, technical sales or business development
  • Strong background within industrial automation, pneumatics, engineering or related technical markets
  • Experience managing large, complex or multi-site customer accounts
  • Exposure to pneumatics, valves, actuators, sensors, motion control, automation equipment or related technologies will be highly regarded
  • Strong commercial skills with experience managing negotiations and significant sales opportunities
  • Proven ability to develop account plans and identify opportunities for long-term customer growth
  • Confidence working with engineering, procurement, operations and senior commercial stakeholders
  • Strong relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills
  • Ability to understand technical applications and translate customer requirements into practical solutions
  • Experience with CRM systems, sales forecasting and pipeline management
  • Self-motivated with the ability to independently manage strategic customer relationships
  • Current driver's licence and willingness to travel across New Zealand as required


On Offer

  • Attractive Base + Super + Performance Incentive + Car Allowance
  • Generous performance-based incentive scheme
  • Car allowance to support customer and territory travel
  • Reimbursement for eligible business travel expenses, including tolls and mileage
  • Opportunity to manage major strategic accounts across New Zealand
  • Comprehensive product and technical training
  • Support from experienced sales, engineering and technical teams
  • Long-term career and professional development opportunities within a global organisation

job.title: Account Manager - Industrial Automation - MEL
job.description:
Account Manager – Industrial Automation

Melbourne, Victoria


My client is seeking an experienced Account Manager to manage and grow an established customer base across Victoria.


Seeking experienced Account Manager with Industrial B2B sales experience

Mechanical Equipment, Pneumatics or Automation background highly regarded

Strong Account Management & Business Development focus


My client is a global manufacturer and provider of industrial automation and mechanical solutions, specialising in pneumatics, valves, actuators, motion control and automation equipment. With an established presence across industrial markets, my client supports customers across manufacturing, food & beverage, process industries and other technical environments.


This is an opportunity for an experienced technical sales professional to take ownership of an established Victorian territory, strengthen existing customer relationships and identify opportunities for further growth.


About the Role

The Account Manager will be responsible for:

  • Managing and growing an established portfolio of customers across Victoria.
  • Building strong relationships with existing customers and key decision-makers.
  • Identifying and developing new business opportunities within the territory.
  • Promoting pneumatic, mechanical and industrial automation solutions.
  • Conducting regular customer visits to understand applications, requirements and upcoming projects.
  • Recommending suitable products and technical solutions based on customer needs.
  • Preparing quotations and managing opportunities from initial enquiry through to order.
  • Developing new accounts across manufacturing, food & beverage, process and other industrial markets.
  • Working closely with my client's technical and customer service teams to support customer requirements.
  • Maintaining accurate sales pipeline and customer activity information within CRM systems.
  • Monitoring competitor and market activity to identify further opportunities for growth.
  • Achieving agreed territory sales, account development and revenue targets.


About You

The successful candidate will have:

  • Previous experience in Account Management, Technical Sales or Business Development within an industrial B2B environment.
  • Experience selling mechanical equipment, pneumatics, automation or related industrial products.
  • Exposure to pneumatic components, valves, actuators, sensors, motion control or automation equipment will be highly regarded.
  • Proven ability to manage and grow an existing customer portfolio.
  • Strong new business development and prospecting capabilities.
  • Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills.
  • The ability to understand technical applications and identify suitable solutions.
  • Excellent relationship-building and communication skills.
  • A proactive approach to managing a sales territory and customer visit schedule.
  • Experience using CRM systems to manage customer activity and sales opportunities.
  • A current Australian driver's licence and willingness to travel throughout the territory as required.


Why Join?

  • Opportunity to work with a well-established global manufacturer.
  • Ownership of an established Victorian sales territory.
  • Existing customer portfolio with genuine scope for further business development.
  • Competitive package including base + super + performance incentive + car allowance.
  • Business-related travel expenses reimbursed.
  • Comprehensive technical and product training.
  • Support from experienced technical and customer service teams.
  • Long-term career development opportunities within a global industrial organisation.


If you are an experienced Account Manager with a strong industrial sales background and an interest in developing an established Victorian territory, this could be an excellent next career opportunity.

job.title: Field Service Engineer – Laboratory Automation - Perth
job.description:
Field Service Engineer – Laboratory Automation

Perth WA


The Opportunity

My client, a growing provider of laboratory technology and automated equipment solutions, is looking for an experienced Field Service Engineer to take ownership of their service coverage across Perth.

This is a home-based, customer-facing position with the majority of work across metropolitan Perth, supporting equipment within hospital and laboratory environments.

Initially operating as the sole Perth-based engineer, the successful candidate will independently manage service calls, customer relationships and territory priorities, while receiving technical support from the wider team and access to locally held spare parts.


Key Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot, service and maintain equipment across hospital and laboratory sites
  • Diagnose technical faults and complete repairs independently
  • Manage service calls, customer follow-ups and daily territory priorities
  • Support equipment installations and commissioning activities
  • Coordinate spare parts and equipment requirements
  • Provide clear technical advice and support to customers
  • Maintain accurate communication with customers and the wider technical team
  • Build strong relationships with customers across the Perth territory
  • Attend occasional regional customer sites as required
  • Support interstate installations when required


About You

  • Strong field service experience across robotics, automation, industrial instrumentation or related technical equipment
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot, diagnose and resolve technical equipment faults
  • Engineering qualification preferred, although substantial relevant technical experience will also be considered
  • Comfortable working independently and managing a territory without daily supervision
  • Strong organisation and ability to prioritise multiple service requirements
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills
  • Confident working directly with customers in hospital, laboratory or other technical environments
  • Willingness to undertake occasional regional and interstate travel
  • Willingness to complete product training, which may include overseas training in Singapore


On Offer

  • Attractive Base + Car Allowance + KPI-Based Bonus
  • Home-based position with predominantly metropolitan Perth coverage
  • Tools and equipment supplied
  • Access to locally held spare parts and technical support
  • Opportunity to take ownership of the Perth service territory
  • Comprehensive product and technical training
  • Opportunity to join a growing laboratory technology business with long-term development opportunities

job.title: Field Service Engineer – Laboratory Automation
job.description:
Field Service Engineer – Clinical Diagnostics

Sydney NSW


About the Company

My client is a growing global provider of clinical diagnostics and laboratory technology, supporting hospitals, pathology laboratories and healthcare providers with sophisticated diagnostic instrumentation and technical solutions.

With an established presence in Australia, the business offers strong technical support, comprehensive product training and long-term career development opportunities.


The Role

An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Field Service Engineer to join the Sydney service team.

This is a customer-facing technical role supporting clinical diagnostic and pathology laboratory instrumentation across metropolitan Sydney.

The successful candidate will be responsible for servicing, maintaining, troubleshooting and installing equipment while managing customer communication and service priorities. Working within busy clinical environments, you will understand the importance of responding quickly when critical diagnostic equipment goes down.

You will be supported by an established local engineering team, technical facilities, spare parts and wider operational resources.


Key Responsibilities

  • Diagnose and resolve faults on clinical laboratory and diagnostic instrumentation
  • Carry out preventative maintenance, servicing and equipment repairs
  • Support installation and commissioning of diagnostic equipment
  • Respond to urgent equipment breakdowns within hospital and pathology laboratories
  • Provide telephone and on-site technical troubleshooting
  • Manage service visits, priorities and customer follow-ups
  • Provide clear technical advice and support to laboratory customers
  • Maintain accurate service documentation and equipment records
  • Coordinate spare parts and technical requirements
  • Build strong relationships with hospital and laboratory customers
  • Participate in an on-call roster approximately once every six weeks
  • Support occasional regional and interstate service or installation requirements


About You

  • Field service experience with IVD, clinical diagnostics or pathology laboratory equipment
  • Exposure to haematology, chemistry, immunology or related clinical laboratory systems
  • Strong hands-on troubleshooting, maintenance and repair capability
  • Experience diagnosing electrical, mechanical, instrumentation or software-related equipment faults
  • Understanding of the urgency of equipment breakdowns within high-volume clinical laboratories
  • Confident managing service requirements and technical issues independently
  • Strong customer service, communication and organisational skills
  • Comfortable working directly with laboratory and hospital customers
  • Engineering qualification preferred, although substantial relevant technical experience will also be considered
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call roster
  • Willingness to undertake occasional regional and interstate travel
  • Willingness to complete comprehensive product training, potentially including overseas training in Singapore


On Offer

  • Attractive Base + Car Allowance + KPI-Based Bonus
  • Macquarie Park base with predominantly Sydney customer coverage
  • Established local engineering and technical support team
  • Tools and equipment supplied
  • Access to technical facilities and locally available spare parts
  • Comprehensive product and technical training
  • Potential overseas product training
  • Long-term career development within a growing global clinical diagnostics business

job.title: Technical Sales - Hydraulic Hose (Copy)
job.description:
The Opportunity

My client is a well-established supplier of hydraulic & industrial hoes and fittings, servicing customers across a broad range of industries throughout Australia. Renowned for technical expertise, premium products, and outstanding customer service, they have built a strong reputation as a trusted partner to manufacturers, OEMs, and industrial businesses.

An exciting opportunity has become available for a Territory Sales Representative to take over an established territory across Southeast Queensland. This role offers the opportunity to manage an existing customer base while identifying new business opportunities and further growing market share.

Covering Brisbane, Toowoomba and surrounding regions, this position is ideal for a relationship-driven sales professional who enjoys working autonomously, solving customer challenges, and delivering technical hydraulic solutions.


About the Role

You will be responsible for managing an established portfolio of customers while developing new business opportunities throughout your territory. Working closely with manufacturers, OEMs, and industrial customers, you'll provide technical advice on hydraulic hoses, hose assemblies, fittings, fluid transfer products, and related industrial solutions, ensuring customers receive the right products and support for their applications.

The territory covers Brisbane Metropolitan and Toowoomba, with occasional travel to regional accounts as required.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and grow an established customer base across Southeast Queensland.
  • Develop new business opportunities within manufacturing, OEM, and industrial markets.
  • Promote hydraulic hoses, hose fittings, fluid transfer products, and related industrial solutions.
  • Provide technical advice and product recommendations based on customer applications.
  • Prepare quotations and manage opportunities through to successful completion.
  • Build long-term customer relationships through regular site visits and a consultative sales approach.
  • Maintain accurate customer records using the company's integrated CRM and ERP systems.


What We're Looking For

  • Previous external sales experience within the hydraulic hose, hose fittings, fluid power, industrial, mechanical, or engineering industries.
  • Experience selling into manufacturers, OEMs, or industrial customers.
  • A degree in Mechanical Engineering or trade background highly regarded 
  • Open to Automotive mechanics, or spare parts backgrounds, seeking a move into an industrial sales role, with a leading manufacturer. A great platform to establish a career in the industry 
  • Mechanical aptitude
  • Excellent relationship-building, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to manage a territory independently.
  • Comfortable with occasional regional travel.


What's on Offer

  • Competitive base salary plus superannuation.
  • Performance bonus structure.
  • Car allowance.
  • Mobile phone and laptop provided.
  • Established territory with an existing customer base from day one.
  • Supportive and collaborative team with genuine long-term career opportunities.
  • Modern CRM and ERP systems to support efficient territory management.
  • High level of autonomy, allowing you to take ownership of your territory and make a real impact.

job.title: Service Technician - Water Treatment
job.description:
Service Technician – Water Treatment & Industrial Services

Adelaide, SA


A leading Australian engineering and environmental services provider is seeking an experienced Service Technician to join its growing Adelaide team. The organisation delivers innovative water treatment and process solutions to customers across manufacturing, mining, utilities, food & beverage, infrastructure, and other industrial sectors.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on technician who enjoys working autonomously, solving technical problems, and delivering exceptional service across a diverse range of customer sites.


The Role

Reporting to the Service Manager, the successful candidate will be responsible for servicing, maintaining, troubleshooting, commissioning, and optimising industrial and commercial water treatment systems throughout South Australia.


Key responsibilities include:

  • Performing preventative maintenance, breakdown repairs and routine servicing on water treatment equipment and systems
  • Diagnosing and resolving mechanical, electrical and process-related faults
  • Commissioning new equipment and supporting plant upgrades and system optimisation
  • Operating and maintaining water treatment plant process units and associated ancillary equipment
  • Conducting inspections, testing and performance assessments to ensure optimal system operation
  • Completing service reports, maintenance records and quality documentation accurately and in accordance with company procedures
  • Maintaining the highest standards of workplace health, safety and environmental compliance
  • Providing professional technical support and building strong relationships with customers
  • Travelling throughout metropolitan, regional and remote areas of South Australia as required, working both independently and as part of a small team


About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • Mechanical, Electrical or other recognised Trade Qualification, or an Engineering qualification
  • Current Electrical Licence
  • Current Australian Driver's Licence
  • 3–5 years' experience in a similar Service Technician or Field Service role
  • Experience within commercial and/or industrial water treatment or a comparable industrial process environment
  • Strong mechanical and electrical fault-finding and troubleshooting skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical and process issues clearly
  • Sound computer literacy and experience completing service reports and quality documentation
  • A strong customer service focus with excellent interpersonal skills
  • The ability to work autonomously, use initiative and effectively manage priorities
  • High attention to detail and a commitment to following quality assurance procedures
  • A positive, reliable and team-oriented attitude with a strong commitment to safety
  • Flexibility to travel and work at regional and remote customer sites when required


What's on Offer

  • Competitive Base Salary
  • Superannuation
  • Performance Bonus
  • Car Allowance
  • Ongoing technical training and career development
  • Opportunity to work on a wide range of industrial water treatment technologies
  • Supportive team environment with genuine long-term career opportunities

﻿

If you're an experienced Service Technician looking for a rewarding role with a respected engineering business delivering

essential water treatment solutions across Australia, we'd love to hear from you.
